physicalNotes: Radius 0.07 Jupiter radii from Muirhead et al. 2012 (2012arXiv1201.2189M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012arXiv1201.2189M/abstract): 5,004.4 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Ofir et al. 2025 (2025AJ....169...90O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...90O/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.00222115 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
